flags.reason: Recommends claude-sonnet-4-5 as the default model, but that model is deprecated and retires on November 30, 2026.
flags.source_quote: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for November 30, 2026. We recommend migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5.
flags.proposed_fix: Here we use `claude-sonnet-5-5`, the recommended replacement for the deprecated Claude Sonnet 4.5.
